narrative.overview: Every tattoo is a cut stone laid on green velvet, captioned by a stock tag, and proved by a loupe. Pieces are shown one at a time at stone scale, never as a thumbnail wall, and no two stones touch. Brass is rationed to what responds; ivory belongs to tags; depth is three planes: tray, tag, lens.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green velvet ground with sheen and pile, never flat black.
One 1px brass rail down the whole page with a bead that marks scroll position.
Ivory stock tags with a punched hole carry every caption and every action.
A brass-ringed loupe magnifies any stone on hover or long-press.
Motion is a stone settling: short, exponential ease-out.

rules.name: The Rationed Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only on what responds to the visitor. If it does not act, it is not brass.

rules.name: The Ivory Is Paper Rule
rules.body: Ivory fills are tags. Headline ivory on velvet is text, never a panel.

rules.name: The Hairline Stays Large Rule
rules.body: Bodoni is used at 20px and up only; below that Manrope takes over so the hairlines never thin out.

rules.name: The No-Touch Rule
rules.body: Stones never touch or overlap each other; caption tags may overhang their own stone by .75rem.

rules.name: The Three Planes Rule
rules.body: Tray, tag, lens. A fourth plane means something is wrong.

dos: Do keep brass to elements that respond: rail, nav, loupe, button edges, focus ring.
Do caption every stone with an ivory tag carrying a hole and ink text.
Do give each stone its lying shadow and leave empty velvet between stones.
Do keep Bodoni at 20px and up; Manrope for everything smaller.
Do keep a visible 2px brass focus ring with 4px offset.
Do keep one stone per row at 639px and below, full width.
donts: Don't fill panels with ivory or use brass as decoration.
Don't build a thumbnail grid or let stones touch.
Don't use flat black grounds or a periodic stripe for the velvet nap.
Don't add hard-edged shadows; the third plane is the lens, not a fourth layer.
Don't invent prices, testimonials or healed photos; slots stay hidden until real.
